scope: Existing canonical Poaceae taxonomy-only name/rank/identity evidence; no species-card, media, genus/family, installation, county nativity or Pages changes.
backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, accessed 2026-10-25; IPNI nomenclatural authorship, WFO alternate citation and Flora of India 2024 competing concept retained separately.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Author citation (L.) P.Beauv. versus (L.) P.Beauv. ex Roem. & Schult.
scientific_decisions.reason: IPNI 404772-1 explicitly credits Beauvois under Shenzhen Code Art. 46.2 and labels ex Roem. & Schult. citation 404773-1 a duplicate citation. Adopt POWO/IPNI standard authorship while retaining alternate source citation as provenance.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatic synonym merge of Heteropogon melanocarpus into H. contortus
scientific_decisions.reason: The distinct accepted H. melanocarpus must not be collapsed into the canonical H. contortus entry; original identifications must be specimen-checked.

scientific_decisions.source_name: New accepted Heteropogon allionii learner card under POWO/WCVP
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: REJECTED — historical alias with unresolved alternative classification
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO treats H. allionii as synonym of H. contortus. Alternative Flora of India 2024 acceptance is recorded but cannot authorize duplicate accepted card under project backbone.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Identification of individual learner photographs or historical Heteropogon specimens
scientific_decisions.reason: Name synonymy does not certify an individual photograph as H. contortus rather than H. melanocarpus or an alternative concept; do not alter image identities, labels or arrows.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Hybrid, introgression, cultivar or ecotype provenance for learner individuals
scientific_decisions.reason: No specimen-specific molecular, crossing, voucher or lineage evidence established in this name audit. Preserve any existing scientific hybrid/identity holds; do not infer hybrid origin or absence from a name.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Heteropogon allionii alternative accepted species concept in Flora of India (2024)
scientific_decisions.accepted_target: POWO accepted H. contortus; alternate treatment retained
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO explicitly notes Flora of India 32 (2024) accepted H. allionii, while POWO/WCVP synonymizes it. Preserve differing taxonomic circumscription without changing the project's accepted name.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Historical specimens identified as Heteropogon allionii or H. polystachyos
scientific_decisions.reason: Synonymy provides nomenclatural routing only; it cannot prove that each old specimen fits a modern H. contortus concept without its diagnostic reproductive structures or voucher review.

identity_note: Existing image labels, source attributions, taxon assignments and hybrid holds were not altered; no individual specimen identity verified by nomenclature.
